WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793221572787
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793826372787
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', '$exception')
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ev WHERE event = '$exception') AS errors,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) FROM ev WHERE event = '$exception') AS visitors,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM ev WHERE event = '$exception') AS sessions,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview') AS sessions_total

SELECT path, MIN(title) AS title, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT distinct_id) AS visitors,
  MIN(COALESCE(NULLIF(referrer_host, ''), 'Direct / None')) AS referrer
FROM ev
WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%404%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%not found%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(title, '')) LIKE '%page not found%' OR LOWER(COALESCE(path, '')) LIKE '%/404%'
GROUP BY path ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 10
